# Backup and Recovery Standard

Revision: v05. Effective: 2024-01-11. Owner: Head of Platform Engineering.

## 1. Purpose

This policy sets the minimum requirements for backup and recovery. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This policy applies to every employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this policy and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Devices that store in-scope data are encrypted at rest with a managed key.
- **R2.** Test and development environments never hold production data unless it has been anonymised.
- **R3.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least every 6 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R4.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.
- **R5.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 90 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R6.** Passwords are at least 14 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R7.** This policy is reviewed every 24 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R8.** Shared accounts are prohibited; every action is attributable to a named individual.
- **R9.** Staff complete the related training within thirty days of joining and annually thereafter.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this policy is the Head of Platform Engineering, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
